product.title: Scottish Highlands, Loch Ness and Glencoe Day Trip from Edinburgh

description.text: This 13-hour coach day from Edinburgh winds through the Highlands to Pitlochry, Cairngorms National Park, Loch Ness, Urquhart Castle, Glencoe National Nature Reserve, and Stirling Castle. An air-conditioned vehicle with panoramic windows and a live driver-guide covers Nessie lore, the Glen Coe massacre, and Wallace-era warfare. Stops include Pitlochry, Cairngorms National Park, Loch Ness, Urquhart Castle, Glencoe National Nature Reserve, Stirling Castle. Check-in is in central Edinburgh near Parliament Square. The long format is built for visitors who want Loch Ness and Glencoe in one guided sightseeing day from Edinburgh.

highlights: Head into the Scottish Highlands and travel through the fantastic landscapes of Cairngorms National Park
See the famous Loch Ness, believed to be home to a mysterious sea creature
Visit Glen Coe, a place known as much for a horrific massacre as its gorgeous scenery
Explore the ancient Urquhart Castle overlooking Loch Ness
